name: sumAcc_zero
prelude:
def mySum : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + mySum xs

def sumAcc : List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => sumAcc xs (acc + x)
statement: theorem sumAcc_zero (xs : List Nat) : sumAcc xs 0 = mySum xs
proofs:
have h : ∀ acc, sumAcc xs acc = acc + mySum xs := by
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro acc; simp [sumAcc, mySum]
    | cons x xs ih => intro acc; simp [sumAcc, mySum, ih]; omega
  simpa using h 0
  have h : ∀ ys acc, sumAcc ys acc = acc + mySum ys := by
    intro ys acc
    fun_induction sumAcc ys acc with
    | case1 acc => rw [mySum, Nat.add_zero]
    | case2 acc x xs ih => rw [ih, mySum, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [h, Nat.zero_add]
